remarks: This fantastic end unit offers many updates. The nice-sized eat-in kitchen boasts a new window (2025), updated neutral-colored solid-surface countertops, a dishwasher, garbage disposal, gas stove, built-in microwave with exhaust fan, and refrigerator. There is also a large pantry closet for additional storage needs. The hallway offers a nice half bath with vanity storage. The large living room is bright and offers updated laminate flooring and new dimmable recessed lighting. Exit to the backyard using the sliding glass door that leads to newly built extra-wide steps and a concrete patio with a fully fenced yard. There is also a back gate that you can access the grassy common area.  The two extra-large bedrooms are located on the second floor. Both have extra-large closets and new dimmable recessed lighting. One bedroom has newer carpeting, and the other has updated laminate flooring.  The full bath located on the second floor has been beautifully remodeled in 2026. The brand-new large shower and ceramic tile floor offer peace of mind.   All other windows have been updated; there is new insulation in the attic, and improved eaves and soffits, both in the front and back. There is a one-car detached garage with a garage door opener and an extra assigned parking space. There is additional parking just across the parking lot for all your guests.  To round everything off, the washer and the dryer stay to make this a true move-in-ready home.See also ML#B1708097.
